newsitem.title: USA: Questar to spend $1.5 bln over next 5 years.
newsitem.headline: Questar to spend $1.5 bln over next 5 years.

text.p: Questar Corp on Tuesday said it plans to spend as much as $1.5 billion over the next five years in a plan to boost its capital-growth projects by 50 percent.

Questar president R.D. Cash said in a press release that 60-70 percent of the spending increases are earmarked for such non-regulated projects as oil and gas exploration and for reserve acquisition. A spokesman said most of the exploration projects are located in the Rocky Mountain region.

"This increased non-regulated emphasis should increase earnings and improve market valuation over the five-year period," Cash said in comments to shareholders at the annual meeting of the $1.8 billion energy-services holding company.
Cash called the move "the most aggressive growth program in our history."
The company said shareholders elected one new member to its board of directors and reelected four others.
